question: Under what temporal condition of practice are old age and death said to be destroyed?
premises: Practice is undertaken for one year.
When that practice has been done, a condition holds.
Old age and death are destroyed under that condition.
inference: When the practice has been performed for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The nature of the practice is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
